children: Bandwidth appointed Emily C. Harlan as General Counsel and Secretary effective September 1, 2026, as R. Brandon Asbill transitioned to General Counsel Emeritus and Assistant Secretary ahead of his retirement on December 31, 2026.
General Counsel Emeritus and Assistant Secretary
Planned leadership transition related to Asbill's retirement
Personal decision to retire; not due to any dispute or disagreement
Succeeded by Emily C. Harlan (General Counsel and Secretary)
Employment agreement commenced Sept 1, 2026; initial base salary $360,000; target incentive 50% of base; RSU award ~ $1,000,000 value; severance and restrictive covenants included
Will continue in non-executive advisory capacity through Dec 31, 2026; will receive current base salary through retirement; eligible for acceleration of certain RSUs in lieu of 2026 target bonus
